view: Gaochang Qocho ruined Buddhist complex in Turpan basin, eye-level broken thick adobe walls and rounded stupa core beside eroded arch recess, dry pale desert and red brown hills distant, distinctive earthen texture, no intact wooden pagodas or lush river.

eras.title: Earthen walls in the basin
eras.caption: Gaochang's walls and ruined religious buildings stand in the dry Turpan Basin. Made largely from earth, they retain the outlines of a city where Silk Road travel brought together merchants, languages and Buddhist communities.
